_note: Settings for the Inventory Holding Cost analysis (src/holding_cost.py). Edit values here; the app reads this file on every load.
_carrying_cost_rate_note: Annual inventory carrying cost rate as a fraction (e.g. 0.20 = 20%/year). NOT SET: no rate exists in the DWH or app. Obtain from Finance (Controlling / Treasury: cost of capital + storage + insurance + obsolescence allowance). Until set, ranking/Pareto/score are computed on average inventory value (identical ordering) and holding-cost amounts show as blank.
_flags_note: Proposed defaults, not approved business rules. high_value_percentile: current inventory value at or above this percentile of valued items = HIGH VALUE. slow_moving_turns: annual consumption value / average inventory value below this = SLOW MOVING.
